en: The postcard features a black and white photo of a large Gothic-style church with a tall spire and clock, set in a circular park-like area with pathways and gardens. The background shows a wooded hill and town buildings. Handwritten Swedish text surrounds the image on the front, and the reverse is addressed to 'Fröken Hanna Jonson' in Karlstad, with a Swedish 5 öre stamp canceled in Sundsvall. Printed text includes 'Sundsvall' and 'Kyrkan och Norra Stadsberget' indicating the church and 'Norra Stadsberget' (North City Mountain).
